info.name: Arcania — Tarot BFF
info.description:
Exercises the public tarot BFF endpoint `POST {{baseUrl}}/tarot/reading` with different readingIds.

## Contract
Body (`UserReadingRequest`):
```
{ "userId": string, "userName": string?, "readingId": string, "question": string, "isForAnotherPerson": boolean }
```
Response (`ReadTarotResponse`): `{ "responseId": "SUCCESS"|"ERROR", "readingId": string }` with HTTP 200.

## Important: this endpoint is fire-and-forget
The route returns 200 + a fresh `readingId` as soon as the request is *accepted*. The actual reading (Gemini call + Firestore write) runs in the background AFTER the response is sent. So:
- A 200/SUCCESS means "accepted", NOT "reading generated".
- Entitlement (`tarot.readings` must contain the readingId) and LLM/parse failures happen async — they only appear in server logs, never in this HTTP response.
- To confirm a reading actually completed, read Firestore `users/{{userId}}/readings/{readingId}` after a few seconds.

## Rate limit
The public route is limited to 20 requests / hour per IP (keyed on X-Forwarded-For). Running the whole collection repeatedly will start returning 429.
